title: Fix Workbench Add Piece Type Model Linking
description: Fix the sketchpad workbench "Add Piece" so that added pieces have the correct linked type models. Currently a sphere is created in the scene window instead of the correct 3D model. Need to fix: 1) correct node in diagram 2) correct model in scene 3) flattenDesign connection errors for missing pieces.
summary: Fixed the root cause of workbench 'Add Piece' rendering box fallback instead of correct type model. The issue was that SketchpadStore.kit(guid) created a new CollaborativeKitStore instance on every call, causing React's useSyncExternalStore to re-subscribe every render, which cancelled in-flight async getFileBlobUrl() calls before they could resolve. Fix: Added collaborativeKitStoreCache Map to SketchpadStore that returns a stable CollaborativeKitStore instance per kit guid. Also added cache cleanup on kit deletion. The flattenDesign 'Skipping connection' warnings are defensive filters in semio/js/index.ts for orphaned connections and don't cause functional issues. All 134 vitest tests pass.
